# Tags

4 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/tags` | List a workspace's tags |
| POST | `/api/v1/tags` | Create a tag |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/tags/{tagId}` | Rename or recolor a tag |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/tags/{tagId}` | Delete a tag |

### GET /api/v1/tags

List a workspace's tags

Returns the organization's tags with per-tag post counts, sorted by name. Any member may read; feeds the Tags settings page and the composer's tag suggestions.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's tags
  - `TagList`
    - `tags`: array of `Tag`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `color`: string, required — Palette color id, e.g. "purple" (see the fixed tag palette)
      - `count`: integer, required — Number of posts (composer groups) carrying this tag
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/tags

Create a tag

Creates a standalone tag (not yet attached to any post). Owner/admin only. Tag names are unique per workspace, case-insensitively.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CreateTagBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `name`: string, required
  - `color`: one of `"grey"` | `"dark-grey"` | `"purple"` | `"blue"` | `"teal"` | `"green"` | `"yellow"` | `"orange"` | `"pink"` | `"red"` (default "grey") — Palette color id — stored colors are constrained to the palette

**Responses**

- `200` — The created tag
  - `TagMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `tag`: `Tag`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `color`: string, required — Palette color id, e.g. "purple" (see the fixed tag palette)
      - `count`: integer, required — Number of posts (composer groups) carrying this tag
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `409` — Conflicts with an existing resource
  - `Error`

### PATCH /api/v1/tags/{tagId}

Rename or recolor a tag

Owner/admin only. Posts reflect the change automatically — they link to the tag by id.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tagId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `UpdateTagBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `name`: string, required
  - `color`: one of `"grey"` | `"dark-grey"` | `"purple"` | `"blue"` | `"teal"` | `"green"` | `"yellow"` | `"orange"` | `"pink"` | `"red"`, required — Palette color id — stored colors are constrained to the palette

**Responses**

- `200` — The updated tag
  - `TagMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `tag`: `Tag`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `color`: string, required — Palette color id, e.g. "purple" (see the fixed tag palette)
      - `count`: integer, required — Number of posts (composer groups) carrying this tag
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
- `409` — Conflicts with an existing resource
  - `Error`

### DELETE /api/v1/tags/{tagId}

Delete a tag

Owner/admin only. The tag is removed from every post carrying it (cascade on the join table).

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tagId` | string | yes |  |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The tag was deleted
  - `TagDeleteResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
